row.notes: (router, pos vec4*, routeRef* {u8 route, u32 volume idx +4} or null): finds the racing::TrackSpaceVolume with Game_TrackSpace_FindVolume 0x1445f3630 on router+8+route*8 (falls back to the other route), projects pos onto the volume gate planes (+0x60/+0x70 normals, +0xc0/+0xd0 ends) and returns the distance along the route (volume start + offset; router+0x48+route*4 = route length). Logs TRACKSPACE 'Could not find racing::TrackSpaceVolume for position (%.3f, %.3f, %.3f) volume index %u type %s' (route names table 0x145634fb0: 'Main', ...). Callers 0x14063e370, 0x142f108c0. Addon: lap distance of any world point (track limits, custom timing, distance-based events). | #587: L2 by lead-authorised promotion for lane owner re-career-teams (independent agree V2278)
